paper_baseline_environment_plans.title: vLLM Isolated Runtime Environment
paper_baseline_environment_plans.python_policy: Create a dedicated venv under tmp/ with --system-site-packages; never install these serving framework dependencies into the project .venv or user site.

manual_packages.name: uvloop
manual_packages.why: The pinned api_server.py imports uvloop, but uvloop is not declared in the inspected runtime requirement files.

manual_packages.name: scipy
manual_packages.why: The --system-site-packages environment can otherwise import an old system SciPy that is incompatible with the NumPy version installed by the pinned vLLM dependency set during Transformers/OpenAI entrypoint imports.

manual_packages.name: pandas
manual_packages.why: H200 serving model inspection imports vllm._aiter_ops, which imports pandas before the server is ready; an old system pandas can be binary-incompatible with the env NumPy under --system-site-packages.

manual_packages.name: numexpr
manual_packages.why: Env-local pandas can still import a binary-incompatible system numexpr unless the package is installed inside the isolated vLLM environment.

manual_packages.name: bottleneck
manual_packages.why: Env-local pandas can still import a binary-incompatible system bottleneck unless the package is installed inside the isolated vLLM environment.

install_commands: env PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PATH=tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin:$PATH tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

REPO_ROOT=$PWD && cd tmp/baselines/vllm && env PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PATH=$REPO_ROOT/tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin:$PATH $REPO_ROOT/tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements/common.txt -r requirements/cuda.txt

REPO_ROOT=$PWD && cd tmp/baselines/vllm && env PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PATH=$REPO_ROOT/tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin:$PATH $REPO_ROOT/tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements/build/cuda.txt

REPO_ROOT=$PWD && VLLM_VERSION_OVERRIDE=$($REPO_ROOT/tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin/python -c "import setuptools_scm; print(setuptools_scm.get_version(root='$REPO_ROOT/tmp/baselines/vllm'))") && cd tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/source-overlays/vllm-27fa5aa3-spinloop-cpython && env VLLM_VERSION_OVERRIDE=$VLLM_VERSION_OVERRIDE PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PATH=$REPO_ROOT/tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin:$PATH $REPO_ROOT/tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin/python -m pip install --no-build-isolation -e .

env PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PATH=tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin:$PATH tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin/python -m pip install 'scipy>=1.15.0' 'pandas>=2.2.0' numexpr bottleneck
execution_gaps: Environment has not been materialized by this planner artifact.
Serving benchmarks still need raw JSON capture after validation passes.
notes: The vLLM source declares torch==2.11.0 while the project venv may carry a different CUDA/PyTorch stack, so the serving baseline must use a dedicated environment under tmp/.
Editable installation is kept in the isolated environment because the installed vllm module and console script are required before server and throughput runs.
The Python 3.10 evaluation host builds vLLM from a copied source overlay that unsets Py_LIMITED_API for the spinloop CXX compile; the pinned upstream checkout under tmp/baselines is not modified.
Editable install derives VLLM_VERSION_OVERRIDE from the pinned upstream checkout before changing into the overlay, because the overlay intentionally omits Git metadata.
